title: The decoder learns the new word
hook: A decoder sometimes receives a dictionary entry it has not written yet.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Build matching encoder and decoder dictionaries from previous phrase plus next first character.

misconception: A dictionary compressor must transmit every new dictionary phrase in full.
objective: Build matching encoder and decoder dictionaries from previous phrase plus next first character.

claims.text: The encoder adds its previous phrase plus the next character. The decoder recreates that dictionary; when it sees the next unassigned code, the required phrase is the previous phrase plus its own first character.
